title: FHR File Converter (fair-bioheaders Python toolkit)
description: fair-bioheaders: convert and validate FAIR-bioHeaders (FHR, FHP, FHT, FHGFF3) metadata in JSON, YAML, JSON-LD, FASTA, GFA, GFF3 and HTML microdata; installs the bioheaders and fhr-* commands. From 0.14.0 this Python toolkit is developed in FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-Python. It continues the FHR File Converter record 10.5281/zenodo.6762547, whose versions up to 0.13.1 were released from FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools.
notes: Historical USDA public-domain material and MPL-2.0 contributions are distinguished in LICENSE and by the version history, which was preserved when the toolkit moved from FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools (commit c7abb7358bbe09796051caa663000cd43bd605f6) to FAIR-bioHeaders-Tools-Python.
